services.name: Demo Flight
services.desc: Person 30 Minute Flight - $310 Person 1 Hour Flight- $600 About Experience the chance to take the controls of a helicopter with one of our Certified Flight Instructors. Both the 30-minute option and the 1-hour option begin with a 10 to 15-minute ground lesson on how the helicopter works and what the controls do, followed by a safety briefing. All flights take place in a Robinson R-44 helicopter, ensuring a safe and exhilarating experience. Our helicopters are equipped with dual controls which allows the student to actually fly the helicopter while the instructor follows 30 Minute Demo - $310 · 1 Hour - $600

services.name: Hartford Skyline
services.desc: Enjoy scenic views of the beautiful Hartford! $215.00 Per Person $480.00 Private Charter for Two About Embark on a captivating tour of Hartford, CT, where history, culture, and modernity converge. From the comfort of our guided tour, immerse yourself in the city’s rich heritage as you pass by iconic landmarks such as the State Capitol, Bushnell Park, and the Wadsworth Atheneum. Marvel at the stunning architecture that blends classical elegance with contemporary flair and learn about Hartford’s role in shaping American history and literature. With fascinating anecdotes and historical 45 minutes • $380 per person • Three Passenger Maximum • All Ages!
